newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland sells PLN 12 mln 10-yr bond,min.price 99.53.
newsitem.headline: Poland sells PLN 12 mln 10-yr bond,min.price 99.53.

text.p: Poland sold 12.261 million zlotys worth of its 10-year variable interest bonds after investors bid for 60.261 million against the finance ministry's one billion zloty offer, the central bank said.
It said in a statement the ministry cut the minimum price by 0.04 point to 99.53 from the last auction on October 8.
The average accepted price of the bonds, maturing January 18, 2007, was also 0.04-point lower at 99.62.
